newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE concerned over Israeli-Palestinian clashes.
newsitem.headline: UAE concerned over Israeli-Palestinian clashes.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates on Saturday expressed concern over four days of clashes between Israeli and Palestinian forces in the West Bank and Gaza Strip in which nearly 70 people have died.
"The United Arab Emirates supports its Palestinian brothers in confronting the agressions of the Israeli forces," the official WAM news agency reported.
It quoted a foreign ministry source as expressing the UAE's "concern over the bloody events in occupied Palestinian lands."
The UAE called on the international community to urge Israel to live up to its commitments to the peace process, WAM said.
The UAE stressed that the implementation of a just peace based on international law and the principle of land-for-peace was the only way to guarantee peace in the Middle East.
The violence erupted on Wednesday over Israel's decision to open a tunnel near Moslem shrines in Jerusalem.
Palestinians called the tunnel's opening an assault on Islamic holy shrines and an Israeli attempt to "Judaise" Arab East Jerusalem, occupied by Israel in 1967 and later annexed.
